units.source_text: 入夜，诸人都觉尚未尽兴。

en.t: When night fell, everyone still felt that the pleasure had not yet run its course.

units.source_text: 于是在庭中点起篝火来，宣召乐人到阶前青苔地上，重新饮酒作乐。

en.t: So they lit bonfires in the garden, summoned the musicians to the mossy ground before the steps, and began drinking and making merry again.

units.source_text: 亲王及公卿都来参与，或弹琴筝，或吹箫管。

en.t: The princes and high courtiers all joined in, some playing zithers and koto, others blowing flutes and pipes.

units.source_text: 乐人尽是特别优秀的专家，他们用箫管吹出双调。

en.t: The musicians were all exceptionally accomplished masters, and they played the sojo mode on their flutes and pipes.

units.source_text: 此时堂上的亲王及公卿便用丝弦和他们合奏。

en.t: At this, the princes and courtiers in the hall accompanied them on stringed instruments.
The dense strings and lively pipes made a splendor beyond compare.

units.source_text: 奏出催马乐《安名尊》之时，不解情趣的仆役也都攒聚在门前几无隙地的车马之间，

en.t: When the saibara piece Anato was performed, even the servants who understood little of refined taste crowded together among the carriages and horses packed before the gate,

units.source_text: 带着笑容听赏，觉得此种生涯真正富有意趣啊！

en.t: listening with smiles and feeling that such a way of life was truly full of charm.

units.source_text: 在春日的天空之下演奏春日的曲调，

en.t: When spring melodies were played beneath the spring sky,

units.source_text: 音乐的效果比其他季节更为优越，这差别人人都体会到。

en.t: the effect of the music was finer than in any other season, and everyone felt the difference.
